why: The equivalence is valid for n>=2. As written it omits this dimension condition; n=1, B=[1], epsilon=1<sqrt(2) has a support-one witness but no pair collision.
fixed_text: For n>=2 and 0<=epsilon<sqrt(2n), a unit vector supported on at most two coordinates witnesses ||B_n x||<=epsilon/sqrt(n) if and only if a projective column collision occurs. The analogous left-witness statement concerns rows.
scope: This fixes the deterministic witness statement only; no issue found with P2's collision probability formula.
